title: Ciyou Temple

buildingCutout.basis: The mapped perimeter of the connected temple building.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified elevation just beyond the south entry on Bade Road.

identities.name: Ciyou Temple
identities.address: Section 4, Bade Road, Songshan District, Taipei, Taiwan

mapIdentity.scope: Official building identity, mapped precinct perimeter, and the exact published daytime temple photograph establish the shell. The Ministry of the Interior identifies the axial progression of halls.

note: The cleared Qualla view and temple records establish five entry bays, three successive halls, triple main eaves, paired bell and drum pavilions, bright golden-orange tiles and ceramic ridge figures.
